en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a stone and timber pier or breakwater extending into a calm sea. On the pier stand utility poles and a small skeletal lighthouse or beacon structure. A sailboat is visible on the right side of the image on the open water, and another beacon stands on a distant breakwater. The card has scalloped edges and printed caption text at the bottom left, plus a small number at the bottom center.
